name: Audit D-19: no privilege escalation
description: v2.22: you can't give out or take away what you don't hold in the tenant (32010): permission and perm set assignments, perm set edits, group members, group and rule mappings, shared rule edits, API key permissions, invitation actions and owners. Ancestors cover descendants. User 1 and tenant owners are exempt; group owners may add and remove members of their group.
